get.description:
Retrieves all current fork choice context, with one node per `(block_root, payload_status)` pair. Each pre-Gloas block has a single `full` node.

Payload Timeliness Committee (PTC) counts are per committee position, including repeated validator indices, and are the same for all nodes of a block. They are zero for pre-Gloas blocks.

204.description: Data is unavailable because the chain has not yet reached genesis

503.description: Beacon node is currently syncing and not serving requests.

400.description: The request could not be processed, check the response for more information.
